caption: The drawing is a black and white line illustration depicting the front façade of a church building identified by the text below as "Misión San Francisco de Solano" with the year "1823" written beside it. The structure has a simple, triangular roof topped with a cross. There are horizontal lines separating the façade into sections that resemble brickwork, alternating in texture. The main entrance is a large rectangular doorway framed by a bold, dark outline, and above the door is a smaller rectangular window, also outlined in dark shading. The building is drawn symmetrically, and the overall composition is centered on the page with empty space surrounding it. The text is written in stylized script on a banner-like shape directly below the illustration. The entire image, including the text, is composed of shades of black and gray on an off-white background.
title: Mision San Francisco de Solano
